'''SoapBox Directory''' is the site-rankings and crypto-resources surface of the [[SoapBox]] ecosystem, published at directory.soapbox.community. It is a curated index of external, publicly useful crypto sites alongside the ecosystem's own, presented read-only and keyless.

== What it lists ==
The directory groups resources by kind, including:
* '''Data & index sites''' and block explorers.
* '''Forums & communities'''.
* '''Wallets''' and '''browser extensions'''.
Each entry links out to the resource itself. A submission page lets anyone propose a site for inclusion.
